verdict.rationale: Weave documents a public REST Service API at https://trace.wandb.ai with API-key bearer auth. The host serves a complete OpenAPI 3.1.0 spec covering 117 paths, plus a live Swagger UI, ReDoc and per-endpoint "Try it" consoles. The probe 404s on docs.wandb.ai paths, and the docs-linked spec 404s, but both are wrong-host or broken-link issues rather than a contradiction, since the working spec is served from trace.wandb.ai. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of driving the product end-to-end through the API, and a consistent spec link in the docs (the docs-listed openapi.json path returns 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Use the Weave Service API, which provides REST endpoints for programmatic access to Weave functionality.

The Weave trace API host serves a complete machine-readable OpenAPI 3.1.0 document at the well-known path, covering the full service surface (117 paths, including /call/start and /calls/stream_query).
The trace API hosts a live Swagger UI that loads /openapi.json, a runnable in-page console against the production API
